$Comment: Skill XP added to what each of Old Jack's three dailies pays: the Hallows_Eve_Daily_Pay table, on
a server running MMO Skill Tree. It folds into that table through ContributesTo, rolls only; see
Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Chain_Pay.json for how a contribution behaves. All three dailies share the table,
so the XP is the event's own skill, Artillery, whichever daily paid it.
